methodology.hypothesis: Sector equity breadth does not describe gold's own trend. Published original worst-episode attribution found larger held gold losses than equity losses. Test an independent existing gold price-trend rule while leaving both original equity-breadth target matrices unchanged; this observed diagnosis is not proof the new rule will work.
methodology.gold_rule: At each original fully informed monthly source decision, preserve its GLD target only when actual GLD adjusted close is strictly above its trailing200-observation simple mean including that close. Equality is off. Otherwise set only GLD to zero and add its removed weight to actual BIL through the unchanged existing component-gate helper. Restore only the original monthly gold target when the fixed condition passes; no rescaling of equity or remaining risk.
methodology.controls: Both fixed half/off source constructions retain every four-style/SOXX equity target, nine-sector signal snapshot,200-sector means, strict structural majority, original monthly risk budgets,125decision dates and2%idle target cash. No daily trigger, Treasury routing, USD/option confirmation, new volatility target, wealth floor, share grid or fitted gold threshold.
methodology.source: Use the original audited twelve-asset portfolio with actual GLD prices and frozen risk-free rates. Keep both separately frozen signal/portfolio XLK versions and original eight-core identity/raw-CSV guards; portfolio XLK remains zero. No new quotes, synthetic gold/risk-free return, future vintage or current-survivor history.
methodology.prior_art: Reuse the prior strict200-observation GLD price/mean law and original unmodified risk-removal helper. The former study also used independent daily equity/gold state changes; this new law is deliberately evaluated only on the existing monthly source clock. It is a newly frozen combination, not an assertion that old whole-portfolio targets or return paths are reproduced.
methodology.selection: Exactly two new existing-factor risk constructions after136exposed-history configurations. The original GLD worst episodes motivated the question, so neither window is an independent holdout. Freeze source/code/specs and publish actual registration before any new accounts. Do not fit mean length, timing, gold scale or source breadth/share rules from new outcomes; retain every failure. No new economic definition or W42/forward rule change.
methodology.execution: Each original10y/5ywindow independently startsUSD10000 including deployment;5bpnext-openbase/20bpextra-sessionstress,USD1/order,fractional long-only funded-v2 and independentbt.
